name: @gjsify/integration-dotenv
description: Integration tests: dotenv on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/process (process.env Proxy round-tripping through GLib.{get,set,unset}env) + @gjsify/fs (readFileSync of .env files, URL-path argument) — the two pillars dotenv pulls together end-to-end.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run setup-fixtures && gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
